description: This file defines the ContentService interface for managing content in a CMS, including methods for listing, retrieving, adding, removing, and updating content and associated files for merchant stores.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: Interface for content management operations in the CMS, extending generic entity service for Content with Long as ID type.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists content by a specific ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists content by multiple ContentTypes, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves content by code and store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a Content object.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves content by code, store, and language.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Stores a content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Stores multiple content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific content file by name and type for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all content files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Fetches a specific content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Gets names of content files for a merchant store and content type.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Adds a logo image for a merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Adds an option image for a merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists Content objects by ContentType and store.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects by ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by ID and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
